problem: The question uses broadcast(notEmpty) in the get() procedure, but get() should signal notFull. The answer also says producers wait on notEmpty, which is wrong; producers wait on notFull.
fix: Change the question to use broadcast(notFull) instead of broadcast(notEmpty). Update the answer to say: "All producers waiting on notFull are awakened. Each will contend for the lock; only one will succeed and put an item, the others will go back to wait because the buffer may become full again. This can cause unnecessary context switches."

problem: The answer lists four components (shared data, procedures, condition variables, implicit lock) while the question asks for three components.
fix: Remove the mention of the implicit lock from the answer. The correct answer: "Shared data, procedures that operate on the data, and condition variables."

problem: The first bullet "Acquire monitor lock" is unrelated to the wait operation and may confuse students.
